summary: The code is syntactically valid and includes several entities and helper utilities, but the simulation is incomplete and will fail at runtime. Critical methods like Simulation.run, Simulation.visualize, Simulation.save_results, and Simulation.validate are missing. The Simulation.step method is truncated and does not compute or record required metrics. Infection transmission dynamics, Rt estimation, and key metrics/validation criteria from the task specification are not implemented.

issues.description: Missing Simulation.run method, yet main() calls sim.run(60). This will raise an AttributeError at runtime.
issues.solution: Implement a run(self, days: int) method that initializes the simulation (if not already initialized), loops over days calling step(day), computes and records metrics each day, and returns results.

issues.description: Missing Simulation.visualize, Simulation.save_results, and Simulation.validate methods, all of which are invoked in main().
issues.location: Class Simulation, missing methods visualize, save_results, validate
issues.solution: Implement visualize (optionally using matplotlib), save_results (write time series to CSV), and validate (run multiple simulations, check validation criteria). Ensure errors are handled if visualization dependencies are absent.

issues.description: Simulation.step method is incomplete and truncates after declaring total_work_visits and work_incidents. It does not finalize daily calculations, update series, or return/record results.
issues.solution: Complete the step method: process workplace visits, compute compliance/adoption rates, update time series (adoption_rate, compliance, enforcement incidents, inventories, prices), adjust retailer prices/supply-chain stockout flags, and trigger adaptive policy adjustments.

issues.description: No infection transmission dynamics or Rt estimation despite being a core requirement. Mask efficacy, location characteristics, and disease transmission probabilities are not modeled.
issues.solution: Add infection state to Person (e.g., susceptible/infected/recovered), model contacts by location using contact rates, and compute infection probabilities modified by mask type efficacy and ventilation/crowding. Track daily new infections, cumulative infections, and compute Rt over time.

issues.description: Required metrics from the specification are not computed or exposed. Only a few series keys exist, with no finalized updates. No calculation of time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak/steady-state adoption, mask_use_by_location_type, cumulative_infections, Rt, infection_reduction_pct, equity gap, or stockout frequency.
issues.solution: Implement metric calculations each day and on completion: adoption_rate_over_time, time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption_rate, steady_state_adoption, mask_use_by_location_type, cumulative_infections, effective_reproduction_number_Rt, infection_reduction_pct, equity_gap_in_adoption, enforcement_actions_count, stockout_frequency.

issues.description: Validation criteria are not implemented (convergence_of_adoption, epidemiological_plausibility, inventory_nonnegativity, policy_effect_sign).
issues.solution: Implement validate to run multiple trials, evaluate adoption convergence, check that Rt < 1 under high adoption/high-efficacy assumptions, verify inventories remain non-negative, and ensure mandates do not reduce adoption relative to a no-mandate baseline.

issues.description: Person and system lack mask type differentiation and efficacy mapping (cloth/surgical/N95) required to modify infection transmission.
issues.solution: Add mask_type attribute to Person (e.g., none/cloth/surgical/N95), implement change_mask_type behavior, and apply mask_efficacy_outward/inward parameters in transmission probability calculations.

issues.description: Equity-related metrics not possible because SES attributes for Person/Household are not integrated into adoption decisions and metrics.
issues.solution: Add SES to Person (or use Household.socioeconomic_status to derive quintiles), influence access_to_masks and affordability, and compute equity_gap_in_adoption between top and bottom SES quintiles.

issues.description: Various series fields are created but never updated (e.g., adoption_rate, compliance_rate, policy_enforcement_level).
issues.location: Class Simulation, series dictionary and step
issues.solution: Update these series at the end of each step with computed daily metrics.

issues.description: main() will crash before reaching the visualize try/except because sim.run(60) will raise due to missing run.
issues.solution: Implement the missing methods or guard calls with hasattr checks and provide graceful fallbacks. Ensure run is implemented to prevent early failure.

issues.description: Nested loops over people and all public locations for visits can be costly at large N and many locations.
issues.solution: Sample locations per person based on foot_traffic_rate rather than iterating all locations, or precompute expected visits and draw from distributions to reduce complexity.

issues.description: csv and sys are imported but not used due to missing save_results. This is harmless but untidy.
issues.solution: Either implement save_results using csv or remove unused imports.
